prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.5%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Companion Personality Showcase Stage']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Move Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Interactive Pet Studio Grid', 'Live Generation Progress & Tips', 'Desktop Placement Ping Button', 'Clear Path Time Estimates', 'Desktop Controls and Interaction Guide', 'Desktop Companion Value Headline', 'Companion Care Tips During Setup Wait', 'Background Rendering System Notification', 'Post-Certificate Account Registration', 'Visual Stage Hatching Sequence', 'Path Differentiation Value Copy', 'Desktop Pet Launchpad Stage Layout', 'Pet Naming and Personality Showcase Screen', 'Account Session Sync Warning Hint', 'Guided Companion Path Selection Flow', 'Desktop Ready System Notification', 'Desktop Interaction Sandbox Screen', 'Account Session Protection Hint', 'Spotlight Path Selection Layout', 'Desktop Audio Readiness Cue']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Founder Adoption Certificate Badge', 'Split View Photo Upload Preview', 'Interactive Hatching Warmup Flow', 'Cloud Account Persistence Redesign', 'Persistent Session Recovery Hint', 'Official Adoption Seal Badge', 'Structured Photo Upload Guidance Layout', 'Desktop Controls Quick-Start Screen', 'Certificate Starter Kit Reward Badge', 'Interactive Story Scroll Path Selector', 'Pet Personality Quiz Stage Layout', 'Split Layout Photo Customization View', 'Hero Path Card Redesign', 'Starter Companion Perk Badge Preview', 'Pet Trait and Appearance Stage Redesign', 'Interactive Desktop Controls Onboarding Screen', 'Desktop Welcome Screen Redesign', 'Existing Account Recovery Warning Hint', 'Photo Upload Guidance Copy Enhancement', 'Pet Naming Confirmation Screen', 'Adoption Companion Archetype Studio', 'Cloud Save Companion Accessory Reward']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, choose_path layout, choose_path new_flow, finish redesign, and home new_flow, as each category has only one test.
Adoption redesign is a helpful change, supported by a confirmed statistically significant win in round 3.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path copy, home wait_info, sign_in reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, or sign_in hint across multiple tests.
Finish notification changes showed no clear positive effect, with one test causing a severe drop that required an early stop.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for minor tweaks while severely underestimating major positive wins like the adoption redesign.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Custom Pet Style Selector Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet choice stage into a stage layout featuring companion style cards and visual choice elements.
candidates.why: Custom pet rendering and selection bugs generated 3 support tickets, and adoption step drop-off is 70.1%.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction First Steps Stage
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated post-onboarding preview screen introducing pet movement, hiding, and chat controls before entering the desktop.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion over controlling or hiding the pet, and finish step conversion is lowest at 64.8%.

candidates.title: Story Prologue After Path Selection
candidates.change: Swaps the onboarding order so users pick their companion path immediately before viewing the background story intro.
candidates.why: Choose path median time is short (8s) but mean is long (514s); letting users pick early increases immediate focus.

candidates.title: Interactive Generation Progress Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds the waiting step with an interactive checklist layout and progress milestone tracking while pet rendering completes.
candidates.why: Home waiting duration is long (median 201s, mean 2336s) and pet generation fails or stalls, causing user drop-off.

candidates.title: Account Sync Verification Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on sign in clarifying that companion save states and pet creations sync safely to the account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or resetting after signing back into an account.

sign_in.hint: Your companion and custom progress are automatically linked and saved to this account.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Tutorial Cards
candidates.change: Updates the home intro screen layout to a two-column view summarizing how to summon, move, and chat with the desktop companion.
candidates.why: Addresses post-onboarding user confusion about controlling and interacting with the desktop pet (3 support emails).

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Learn how to summon, move, and chat with your pet directly on your desktop.

candidates.title: Pet Customization Safeguard Hint
candidates.change: Displays guidance text on the photo upload screen recommending photo clarity to ensure proper companion rendering.
candidates.why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation failures or corrupted avatar appearances.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit, clear photos for best companion rendering results.

candidates.title: Companion Path Overview Copy
candidates.change: Revises headline and body text on the choose path screen to clearly explain custom vs pre-made pet path options.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users immediately; clarifying options upfront improves initial activation.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion Path
choose_path.body: Pick between standard archetypes or build a custom pet that lives on your screen.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Readiness Notification
candidates.change: Enables live time estimates and status hints on the waiting screen to set expectations during background pet generation.
candidates.why: Home waiting step takes a median of 201s and 3 support emails reported desktop pet opening/display failures.

waiting.hint: Preparing your desktop pet engine... almost ready!

candidates.title: Instant Account Access Incentive
candidates.change: Displays a cloud backup status badge during sign-in to motivate account completion and promise pet state protection.
candidates.why: Sign-in step drops 27.1% of users, and missing pets after sign-in is the single largest support complaint (8 emails).
